definition_zh: 嗜酒的；爱灌酒的；吸水的；易透水的
definition_en: fond of drinking alcohol; absorbent, able to soak up liquid
core_image: 一端是举杯不放手的老酒客，一端是喝饱墨水的厚纸
scene: 宴席散场，他还扶着吧台不肯走。The bibulous uncle told the same story three times.
sceneCN: 这里 bibulous 是「嗜酒的、贪杯的」（第 1 个义项：好酒贪杯）；句意是贪杯的舅舅把同一个故事讲了三遍。

derivatives.zh: bibulous 加 -ly，义为「嗜酒地；吸水地」
bibulous 加 -ness，义为「嗜酒；吸水性」
同根动词，义为「喝；饮；吸收」
同根名词，义为「痛饮；豪饮」

senses.title: Fond of drinking alcohol
senses.definition: given to drinking a lot of alcohol, often cheerfully
senses.definitionCN: 好饮大量酒类，常带乐呵呵的劲头
senses.example: The bibulous uncle told the same story three times.
senses.exampleCN: 贪杯的舅舅把同一个故事讲了三遍。
senses.why: Latin bibere means to drink, so the drinker gets the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bibere 意为「喝」，爱喝之人便得了这个形容词。

senses.title: Absorbent of liquid
senses.definition: highly absorbent, soaking up liquid readily
senses.definitionCN: 极易吸收液体，如纸或土壤
senses.example: Bibulous paper blotted the spilled ink at once.
senses.exampleCN: 吸水纸立刻吸干了洒出的墨水。
senses.why: Paper, like a toper, drinks up everything poured.
senses.whyCN: 纸张如酒客，倒多少喝多少。

senses.title: Of convivial drinking occasions
senses.example: Their club held a bibulous annual dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的俱乐部每年举办酒酣耳热的晚宴。
senses.why: The drinkers' mood spreads to the whole gathering.
senses.whyCN: 酒客的兴致弥漫至整场聚会。

senses.title: Sozzled, tipsy
senses.example: The bibulous crowd sang through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 醉醺醺的人群唱了一整夜。
senses.why: From loving drink to being full of it is a short step.
senses.whyCN: 从贪杯到灌满，一步之遥。

senses.title: Permeable, letting liquid through
senses.definition: permitting liquid to pass or soak through easily
senses.example: The bibulous wall took paint unevenly.
senses.exampleCN: 渗水性强的墙面吃漆不匀。
senses.why: A surface that drinks liquid takes stain as a toper takes wine.
senses.whyCN: 喝液体的表面，吃色如酒客吃酒。

senses.title: Spongy in texture
senses.definition: soft and spongy, like material that drinks in moisture
senses.definitionCN: 质地柔软多孔，如吸湿材料
senses.example: The bibulous cloth wrung out heavy and dark.
senses.exampleCN: 那块吸饱水的布拧出来又沉又黑。
senses.why: Sponge-like matter is the paper sense extended.
senses.whyCN: 海绵质是吸水义的延伸。

senses.title: Absorbing like a habitual drinker (figurative)
senses.definition: greedily taking in information or influence, as if drinking
senses.definitionCN: 贪婪吸收信息或影响，如同畅饮
senses.example: She read with bibulous appetite, devouring every review.
senses.exampleCN: 她如饥似渴地读，连每篇书评都不放过。
senses.why: Drinking imagery turns intellectual when applied to reading.
senses.whyCN: 饮的意象落到阅读上，便成了求知如渴。

senses.title: Humorous, formal label for tipplers
senses.definition: a formal or jocular way to call someone a habitual drinker
senses.definitionCN: 以书面诙谐语气称人好酒成性
senses.example: The essay sketched the town's most bibulous citizens.
senses.exampleCN: 文章勾画了镇上最好酒的一群人物。
senses.why: Learned Latin dress makes the drinking joke polished.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁腔的学究外衣，让酒话也显得文雅。

intro.en: Bibulous comes from Latin bibere, to drink, plus the adjective suffix.
intro.cn: bibulous 源自拉丁语 bibere「喝」，加形容词后缀构成。

items.en: the root peh₃- meant to drink; reconstructed form.
items.cn: 词根 peh₃- 意为「饮」（重构形式）。

items.en: bibere meant to drink, whence bibulus, drinkable or fond of drink.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bibere 意为「喝」，派生 bibulus，义为「好饮的」。

items.en: related forms gave imbibere, to drink in, source of English imbibe.
items.cn: 相关形式派生出 imbibere「饮入」，即英语 imbibe 的来源。

items.en: bibulous appears in the early 17th century meaning absorbent.
items.cn: 17 世纪早期 bibulous 首见，义为吸水的。

items.en: the drinker sense, humorous and formal, is now the common one.
items.cn: 如今常用的是诙谐书面化的「嗜酒」义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin drink root; the near-meaning group gathers drinking and absorbing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁「饮」词根；近义组汇集饮酒、吸水类词。

entries.definitionCN: 口渴的——指当下之渴，非嗜好
能吸收的——吸水义的中性对应词

entries.definition: drinking alcohol regularly in small amounts
entries.definitionCN: 常啜酒的——口语化的嗜酒表达

normalIntro.cn: bibulous 是拉丁语 bibere（喝）加 -ous。

normal.en: The drinker sense is humorous and formal.

abstract.en: See a blotter swallow a spill of ink.
Feel the soil drinking the spring rain.
Picture an uncle who never lets his glass stand empty.
abstract.cn: 想象舅舅的酒杯从不见底。

examples.en: The bibulous uncle told the same story three times.
examples.cn: 贪杯的舅舅把同一个故事讲了三遍。

examples.en: Bibulous paper blotted the spilled ink at once.
examples.cn: 吸水纸立刻吸干了洒出的墨水。

examples.en: Their club held a bibulous annual dinner.
examples.cn: 他们的俱乐部每年举办酒酣耳热的晚宴。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必不漏事」——酒杯必不漏，来者不拒全喝光，吸水如纸、嗜酒如命。

root: 拉丁语 bibere「饮」（词根上溯至原始印欧语 peh₃-「饮」，重构形式）派生 bibulus「好饮的」；17 世纪英语借入 bibulous，先义「吸水的」，后长出诙谐的「嗜酒的」义；同根词有 imbibe、bibulation。

sensesIntro.en: One Latin drink-root yields both the toper and the blotting paper.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个拉丁「饮」根，既造出酒客，也造出吸墨纸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something or someone that drinks all it is given
core.cn: 核心意象：来者不拒、照单全「饮」

intro.en: Bibulous is a Latin drink-root with an adjective suffix.
intro.cn: bibulous 由拉丁「饮」词根加形容词后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The bibere family in Latin and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bibere 词族及其英语后裔。

items.meaningCN: 嗜酒的（拉丁原生形容词）

items.structure: from Latin potio, same PIE root
Greek syn- plus pinein, cognate idea
items.meaningCN: 酒会；研讨会（希腊同义构词）
